title: City Council Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to adopt Ordinance #25-10, an ordinance amending and fixing the boundaries of a zone district of the Sandy City Zoning Ordinance; rezoning one parcel, approximately 0.43 acre from CN "Planned Center-Neighborhood Commercial District" to RM(12) "Residential Multi-Family District" at twelve units per acre, located at approximately 1270 E 8600 S; also providing a saving clause and an effective date for the ordinance
